known_risks: 中文：强制 JP v96 中防御强化效果 ID 的全部直接检查；它只允许带盾武器格挡原本不可防御的攻击，普通可防御攻击无法验证此效果。对照时只启用本项并关闭 #65，再使用带盾武器测试原本不可防御的攻击。 / English: Forces every direct JP-v96 check for the Guard Up effect ID; it only lets shielded weapons guard normally unblockable attacks, so ordinary blockable attacks cannot validate the effect. For an isolated comparison, enable only this pack, disable #65, and test a normally unblockable attack with a shielded weapon.
license: MIT for repository-authored metadata and patch source; no game assets included.
summary: 中文：强制发动防御强化/Guard Up，使带盾武器能够格挡原本明确不可防御的攻击。 状态：Runtime Experimental，默认关闭。 / English: Forces Guard Up, allowing shielded weapons to block attacks that are explicitly normally unblockable. Status: Runtime Experimental; disabled by default.
